name: Naive UI
summary: Vue 3 component library with 90+ tree-shakable TypeScript components and a type-safe theme system.
description: A fairly complete Vue 3 component library: more than 90 tree-shakable components written in TypeScript, with a type-safe theme system that needs no CSS/Less/Sass imports or webpack loaders. Data components use virtual lists by default, and the project recommends xicons as its icon library.
contains: type-safe theme system; no CSS/Less/Sass imports needed
data components use virtual lists by default
recommends the xicons icon library; Sketch design resources
